description: Recover executor and review queue-state reconciliation for dynamic workflow recovery lanes so completed same-trace work converges to one coherent durable outcome instead of leaving stale task residue or duplicate review:init tokens, and so the remaining residual lanes can be classified confidently as complete, safe manual-repair, or superseded queue noise.

context.customerAsk: Recover executor and review state reconciliation for dynamic workflow recovery lanes so completed executor or review work no longer leaves stale task failures, active task:init residue, or duplicate review:init tokens for the same trace, while also explaining the remaining three residual lanes concretely enough for a later planner pass to classify each one as complete, safe manual-repair, or superseded queue noise without guesswork.
context.problem: Live queue evidence and worktree evidence diverge for three recovery lanes, including failed task residue and duplicate review:init state that no longer matches completed implementation and review-ready worktree progress. That mismatch blocks further planning because the owning queue-reconciliation path is not explained well enough to tell whether the problem is active runtime behavior, projection drift, duplicate review creation, failed post-processing, or historical queue residue.
context.solution: Inspect the exact runtime, projection, and same-trace ownership path for executor completion, review creation, review completion, and residue cleanup; implement the smallest safe reconciliation fix so one recovery trace produces one durable queue outcome; and, only if runtime behavior is already correct, document the exact safe preconditions for a bounded manual repair path.

acceptanceCriteria: Focused backend tests, replay coverage, or equivalent behavioral proof show that completed executor or review work no longer leaves duplicate review:init tokens or stale task:init or task:failed residue for the same recovery trace.

The implementation or investigation output explains the current residual state of dynamic-workflows-recovery-session-backend-runtime, dynamic-workflows-recovery-mcp-install-plan-scope, and dynamic-workflows-recovery-setup-workspace-git-pull-hygiene concretely enough that a later planner pass can classify each lane as complete, safe manual-repair, or superseded queue noise without guessing.

If durable runtime behavior is already correct and a manual move remains necessary for historical residue, the final repair path records exact safe preconditions, the exact lane shapes it applies to, and the exact queue states it must not be used for.
The recovered behavior keeps executor completion, review creation, review completion, and consume-path state transitions aligned across runtime state and replayed projections for the same trace.

The work stays within existing Factory runtime, session, service, and projection vocabulary and does not introduce a standalone workflow-run model, new customer-facing dynamic-workflow nouns, or unrelated product-surface work.
Quality gate: typecheck, lint, and focused backend tests for factory runtime, session execution, service, and replay surfaces pass.
